findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: cattle_buying_request · Private data: inmag_history, dte_lookup, create_price_alert · Public sink: herd_liquidation_index, market_match, cattle_buying_request, create_price_alert · Destructive: price_seasonality, create_price_alert.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: cattle_buying_request · Private data: inmag_history, dte_lookup, create_price_alert · Public sink: herd_liquidation_index, market_match, cattle_buying_request, create_price_alert · Destructive: price_seasonality, create_price_alert

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
